evaluation.rationale: The candidate notes suffer from a severe failure to resolve the final state of the meeting. They chronologically list superseded ideas (like the October 16-19 dates and Priya booking the cabin) as final decisions and action items, while simultaneously listing the actual final decisions elsewhere, creating massive contradictions. Furthermore, many items that were definitively resolved (pets, private chef, departure time) are listed under 'Open questions'. The structure is chaotic, featuring duplicate sections (e.g., 'Action items' and 'Action items (structured)'), making the notes incredibly repetitive and difficult to read.
